narrative.details: The situation in Raven Hill is still grim.  The safety of Darkshire is in your hands, adventurer.  I don't have enough Watchers to keep the town safe.  We need you to dispatch for Raven Hill yet again and rid the eastern mausoleum of 20 Plague Spreaders!
narrative.objectives: Commander Althea Ebonlocke of Darkshire wants you to kill 20 Plague Spreaders in the eastern Raven Hill mausoleum.
narrative.offerRewardText: On behalf of the people of Darkshire and as the Leader of the Night Watch, I thank you, adventurer, for your bravery and dedication. May the Light shine upon your ways.
narrative.requestItemsText:
I need your assistance, adventurer. Travel to the cemetery to the northwest and rid the eastern mausoleum of 20 Plague Spreaders.

Return to me when your task is complete.
